title: Shipping policy
html:
At Fernwork, we want your order to arrive safely and on time, whether it is a single ceramic vase or a full-size houseplant.

Processing Time

Orders are normally packed and handed to the carrier within 1–2 business days. Orders placed on weekends or holidays are processed on the next business day.

Delivery Times and Costs

Standard delivery within the United States usually takes 3–7 business days after dispatch. Shipping options, estimated delivery dates and costs are calculated at checkout based on your address and the items in your order, and are shown before you pay.

We currently ship within the United States only.

Live Plants

  • Plants are shipped early in the week so they spend as little time as possible in transit.
  • If temperatures along the route are extreme, we may hold your order and contact you to agree on a new dispatch date.
  • Please open your plant parcel as soon as it arrives and place the plant in bright, indirect light.

Fragile Items

Ceramics, glass and lanterns are wrapped individually and packed with protective padding in sturdy boxes.

Tracking

Once your order ships, we will email you a confirmation with tracking details where available.

Damaged or Missing Parcels

If your order arrives damaged, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery for plants, or within 7 days for other items, and include your order number and clear photos of the item and packaging. If a tracking page shows your parcel as delivered but you cannot find it, please contact us and we will help investigate.

Return eligibility and shipping responsibilities are covered by our Refund Policy and applicable consumer protection laws.

Contact Us

Questions about shipping? Email us at hello@fernwork.example.
